text: E ewnaango immorde ka Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on, haa e yimɓe ɓen fow, ñalaande boragol nden, wonnde : Alla seniiɗo On ko daɗndiiɗo(hisdo) e sirkooɓe ɓen, Nulaaɗo Makko on kadi ko daɗndiiɗo e maɓɓe. Si on tuubii -onon sirkooɓe ɓen-, on yaltii e sirku, ko ɗum ɓuri moƴƴannde on. Si on ɗuurnike non e tuubugol, haray fellitee wonnde on laawotaako Alla on laawotaako kadi lepte Makko ɗen. An Nulaaɗo, humpitir ɓen yedduɓe huunde saɗtaynde e maɓɓe, ɗum woni lepte muusuɗe no habbii ɓe.
